newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse halts trade due to technical problem.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse halts trade due to technical problem.

text.p: Trading at the Athens stock exchange was halted about 30 minutes after a delayed open because of technical problems with the bourse's electronic trading system, a bourse official said.
"Right now trading has stopped, it is too early to say when it will resume. Previous trades may have to be cancelled," said Tasos Sgouros, responsible for the exchange's trading system.

The open was delayed 15 minutes after shares of newcomer Xiosbank and other bank listings showed erroneous prices. The index was up more than 0.5 percent in early trade. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
